game_start.intro: ဂိမ်း စတင္တယ္. တရာ အမျိုးအစား: {trump_suit} (တရာ ကတ်: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
သင္ ကစားသမား {player_id} က ဂျာမန္ ဝစ္ ဂိမ္းမ်ားမ်ား. 
{phase_info}
သင္ လက္ထဲ ကတ် {hand_size} ပဲ ရိုက္တယ္. 
'[play N]' နဲ့ ကတ် ကစားလိုက္ (ဥပမာ '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: No card is on offer - the playing phase has begun.
next_card.deck_empty: Dai hta, hpa mung n lawm ai.

invalid_move.wrong_format: N jaw ai shamu shamawt hkrang. Na a lata hta nga ai Nth card hpe ginsup na matu '[play N]' hpe lang u.
invalid_move.bad_position: Dai card shara gaw n nga ai. Nang hta {hand_size} cards rawng ai.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Dai zawn galaw nna, {lead_suit} hpe ginsup ra ai.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Dai gaw n mai galaw ai.

game_action.played: ကစားသမား {player_id} က {card} ကတ် ကစားလိုက္တယ္.

trick.won: ကစားသမား {winner_id} {card} နဲ့ တရာ အနိုင္ရတယ္.
trick.won_learning: ကစားသမား {winner_id} {card} နဲ့ တရာ အနိုင္ရတယ္ နဲ့ မျက်နှာ ဖွင့္ ကတ် ယူလိုက္တယ္.

phase.learning_complete: The deck is exhausted. The learning phase is over - every remaining trick counts towards victory.

draw.winner_received: Nang awng dang nna {card} lu wa ai.
draw.loser_received: Nang gaw hkalem hkalau ai lam hpe sum mat nna, {card} ngu ai lawu na sumla kaw nna lata dat u.

turn.scores_learning: တရာ အနိုင္ရတဲ့ အရည် - ကစားသမား 0: {tricks0}, ကစားသမား 1: {tricks1}
turn.scores_playing: ရမည့္ တရာ - ကစားသမား 0: {tricks0}, ကစားသမား 1: {tricks1}
turn.phase_learning: Phase: {phase} ({remaining_cards} deck hta ngam nga ai card ni)

trick_view.empty: No cards played yet this trick.
